content.value: Are IP address alone sufficient for communication between applicationś? Suppose, you (13) [CO4] have a web server that hosts three web applications on ports 3000, 5000, and 8000, but for some reasons users can't access them via standard HTTP/HTTPS requests using the domain name. Identify the underlying issue and recommend an appropriate solution to enable access via standards ports. Illustrate your approach with a request-routing diagram.
